why_primary_method_dominates: WhiteHawk's claim is a royalty on a physical inventory held in fee through an Up-C, and only a paired owner-cash and unit-NAV method values both the cash the producing wells pay today and the inventory behind them without counting the same molecules twice. The pairing is now correctly populated for the first time. Corroborating methods remain subordinate for stated reasons: comparable transactions cannot lead because the workspace indexes zero third-party sources, and replacement cost is inapplicable to a mineral interest. The decisive structural fact, established this round, is that SEC rules bar a non-operated mineral owner from booking PUDs it cannot commit to develop, so WhiteHawk's proved reserves are 98% PD / 2% PUD by construction. Any method anchored on proved reserves alone values the company as if operators stop drilling forever. The two legs are summed over a partition of disjoint volumes, never averaged.
methods_rejected_for_averaging: The owner-cash and unit-NAV legs are additive over disjoint volumes: 178,544 MMcfe producing against an 8,783-location undeveloped inventory. They are not blended to manufacture a consensus number, and the contract reports no double-counting flags.

The 2026-08-10 range of $4.86/$5.72/$6.83 was not averaged with this one. It was superseded: it credited only the 430 booked locations and valued the other 8,353 audited locations at zero, which the restored filing shows to be wrong.
agreed_facts: Proved reserves at 2025-12-31 are 206,473 MMcfe (178,544 producing) with PV-10 of $293.690m and a standardized measure of $266.326m, per the CG&A reserve report.

There are 8,783 gross undeveloped locations and 28.0 net; 430 sit in the reserve report and the other 8,353 were audited and approved by CG&A. Basin-weighted these carry 385-574 Bcfe net, 1.9-2.8x the entire proved book.

The Note Purchase Agreement requires Consolidated Total Net Leverage of not more than 3.50x, Asset Coverage of at least 1.00x and Liquidity of at least 10%; the revolver adds a 3.00x test; restricted payments including dividends require pro forma leverage below 2.00x. Actual leverage is about 0.9-1.0x.

The same agreement mandates fixed-price swaps on at least 75% of projected PDP production for 36 months from closing and at least 50% rolling thereafter. Royalty revenue is therefore not an unhedged commodity pass-through.
49 consecutive monthly dividends totalling roughly $37m were paid pre-IPO on the predecessor share classes; no dividend has yet been declared as a public company.
Pro forma FY2025 CAFD is $36.317m against DD&A of $36.451m and a net loss of $32.330m; pro forma operating cash flow was $9.533m and pro forma Q1 2026 operating cash flow was negative $10.714m.
Contract value per Class A share is $6.12 / $8.76 / $12.81 against a price of $26.16, an annualised return of -18.74% / -14.47% / -9.70% over seven years.

On April 22, 2026 the company concluded its FY2025 audited statements could no longer be relied upon, citing management-fee recording and acquisition cash misclassification, and identified material weaknesses in internal control.
disputed_facts: The realisation haircut on the undeveloped inventory. hk holds 0.10-0.25 may be far too deep and that at 0.40 the total clears $14; the band is a timing proxy for a conversion schedule nobody has built, and it is now the largest single determinant of value in the contract.

Whether the credit-cycle seat should price commodity risk at all. marks_credit_cycle recorded for a second round that its vote is on price, not credit, and that if cyclical risk belongs in the 9-12% discount rate the contract already applies then its own rejection double-counts it.

Whether roughly 2.7x PV-10 is a premium or a normal clearing price for Appalachian minerals. Unresolved and now established as unresolvable from this workspace, which holds no comparable transactions for any mineral package.

value_range_per_share.basis: Sum of pdp_royalty_cash_stream (4.34/5.01/5.89) and undeveloped_location_inventory (1.77/3.76/6.92), floored at zero for limited liability.
value_range_per_share.known_bias: Generous in two respects and conservative in two. It anchors on pre-tax PV-10 rather than the after-tax standardized measure, and it charges no recurring corporate overhead: capitalising $8m/yr over the proved life would remove about $1.57 per share. Against that, senior claims are overstated by the unreflected $6.3m April 2026 prepayment (+$0.23), and the pro forma preferred dividend appears unadjusted for the Series D redemption ($4-5m of understated CAFD). No case credits a gas deck above the SEC trailing $3.387/MMBtu.

entry_ranges.note: Derived from the decision-grade contract; not a capital instruction. The current price is roughly 8x the 15% base hurdle entry, against 12x before the inventory was credited.

recommendation.rationale: Two of three raters reject and the third votes watch; no rater approves and no rater finds a positive-return case in any scenario. The finding should be read narrowly: this rejects the security at $26.16, not the business, and the evidence base improved materially this round. Every rater raised at least two scores, and all three now record the packet as sufficient where two called it insufficient a day earlier. The remaining objection is uniform and simple: even crediting an audited inventory 1.9-2.8x the proved book, and even on the most generous case in the range, the contract cannot reach a positive return at this price. The committee does not size capital and does not decide; this routes to human_decision.json.
conditions_that_would_reopen: An operator development schedule or acreage census that dates the inventory conversion, replacing the realisation haircut that now drives the answer.
The first 10-Q as a public company, ending the pro-forma-only evidence base and disclosing the actual swap strikes.
A declared dividend policy, converting the 49-month pre-IPO record into a public commitment.
A forward gas deck materially above the SEC trailing $3.387/MMBtu, the one lever absent from every case.
A material price decline toward the $3.29-$4.50 hurdle band.

dissent_preserved.dissent: The 0.10-0.25 realisation haircut may be far too deep. It is applied to volumes 1.9-2.8x the proved book, making it the largest single determinant of value in the contract, ahead of the reserve report itself. If operators convert at anything like the 126-198 wells/yr implied by WhiteHawk's disclosed 18% participation in new Appalachian and Haynesville wells, the correct haircut is nearer 0.40 and the total clears $14. Crediting inventory raised base value 53% without changing one fact about the producing wells; that sensitivity is the finding.
dissent_preserved.chair_response: Accepted and elevated to the primary open item. The committee has moved the dominant uncertainty from 'does inventory exist' to 'when does it convert', which is progress, but the second question is not answered in this packet and the contract's range understates the uncertainty around it.

dissent_preserved.dissent: Raised downside_control from 2 to 4 on the covenant package, the mandatory hedge and the 49-month dividend record, and stated for a second round that its vote is on price rather than credit. Separately: the mandatory hedge caps the gas-price upside the market appears to be paying for, since 50-75% of producing volumes are sold forward three years at a time, and the actual strikes are unfiled.
dissent_preserved.chair_response: Recorded without override. A credit seat voting on price is a real structural comment on this committee's composition, not a defect in the vote, and the hedge-caps-upside point is the strongest argument yet advanced against the market's implied growth.

dissent_preserved.dissent: Holds that the packet suffices to determine asset value even though it cannot explain the market multiple, and that the omission of capitalised corporate overhead makes the valuation too generous by about $1.57 per share rather than too harsh.
dissent_preserved.chair_response: The overhead omission is accepted as a real bias in the contract and is recorded in known_bias rather than corrected mid-round.

evidence_gaps_blocking_decision_grade_us: Operator development schedules, which determine the conversion pace the inventory component depends on.
The actual swap schedule: notional volumes, strikes and tenor.
Any forward gas price deck; every case holds the SEC trailing $3.387/MMBtu.
Comparable transactions for Appalachian mineral packages, absent from the workspace entirely.
Remediation status of the identified material weaknesses.
The prospectus's unreconciled 24.8% versus 28.8% OpCo ownership discrepancy.

First declared dividend and stated payout policy, against the roughly $1.30 per Class A share the pro forma CAFD run-rate implies.
FY2026 10-K reserve report: proved reserves, PV-10, SEC price deck, and the gross and net undeveloped location count.
Operator 2027 capital budgets for EQT, Antero, Range and CNX, which drive WhiteHawk's 18% new-well participation.

price_review_thresholds: Price at or below $12.81, the contract high case, warrants a full re-underwrite.
Price at or below $4.50 clears the 10% base hurdle.
Price above $35 without a reserve or production catalyst widens the unexplained multiple further.
thesis_break_conditions: Reported CAFD above $42.0m, implying a producing decline shallower than the reserve report supports.
Fewer than 6,000 gross undeveloped locations, or fewer than 20 net, on the next census.
PV-10 above $500m, or blended PV-10 unit value outside $1.00-$2.00 per Mcfe.
Senior claims above $225m, which would push leverage through the 2.00x restricted-payment gate.
